name: Recital AE
title: REPORT on the European Semester for economic policy coordination: employment and social priorities for 2025
part_text: AE. whereas country-specific recommendations in the context of the European Semester tend to incentivise cuts to social services and social protection instead of promoting the increase of public revenues; whereas from the introduction of the European Semester in 2011 to the year 2018, the Commission recommended 63 times that governments cut spending on healthcare or privatise health services;
